test_title: PYST 48: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 11 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Football fans __are feeling proud of their teams__ when they win.

options.text: are feel to proud of their teams

solution:
The solution is **feel proud of their teams**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option that can substitute 'Football fans are feeling proud of their teams__ when they win.' is feel proud of their teams.
 
• Football fans __feel proud of their teams__ when they win.
 
• Therefore **option 2 **is the correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The given sentence is simple present tense.
 
• The Simple Present is the tense that we use to refer to events, actions, and conditions that are happening all the time, or exist** **now.
 
• For example: I live in Mumbai, He loves chocolates.
